incidents.raw_content:
Incoming email from customer on 22 March with subject: “Damaged parcel received – unacceptable condition”. 

Customer attaches 4 images showing a crushed DHL box, torn side panels, and bubble wrap exposed. Product inside appears to be a coffee machine (customer did not confirm brand).

Email body states shipment MY987623400 arrived two days late and external box was already damaged when handed over. Customer did not reject delivery because courier mentioned “cannot take back once scanned”. After opening the box, customer noticed water leakage marks and dents on the machine casing.
Internal Teams chat between delivery partner and hub supervisor mentions: “Package already dented when offloaded from linehaul, maybe stacking issue.” Another message says, “No exception scanned at hub, driver might have forgotten.”
Call center notes say customer demanded replacement or refund and is threatening to post photos on social media. Agent marked case as “damage – investigation needed” but forgot to tag the insurance/claims team.
Handwritten warehouse remark uploaded later reads: “Inbound pallet unstable, one carton collapsed, taped back.” No pallet ID referenced.
Issue involves late delivery, damaged item, missing exception scan, and complaint escalation. Multiple teams involved but no clear timeline or responsible department. Priority unclear.

incidents.raw_content:
Customer email on 10 May with subject: "Received wrong parcel – this is not mine". Shipment referenced: MY88123456.
 
Customer states she received a box addressed to a different name and different street in Subang Jaya. Her own shipment (a birthday gift ordered online) has not arrived. Email tone is distressed as the gift was time-sensitive.
 
Delivery scan in system shows MY88123456 as "Delivered – POD obtained" at 3:14 PM on 9 May. Recipient signature on POD is illegible. Photo proof attached to system shows a green front door – customer says her door is white.
 
WhatsApp message from customer on 10 May evening: "I got someone else's parcel. I opened it already thinking it was mine. Now what do I do???"
 
Driver note logged in route app: "Two parcels same street, delivered both together." No further detail on whether both addresses were verified before handover.
 
Second customer (owner of the parcel MY88123456 recipient received) has not yet filed a complaint as of incident report date.
 
Call center agent attempted to cross-reference both waybills but found they share the same route code and postcode. Agent noted "possible mix-up at route sorting stage" but no formal investigation ticket raised.
 
Internal chat between hub ops and courier supervisor: "Driver new, still learning area." Supervisor replied: "Tell him to go collect the wrong parcel back." No follow-up action confirmed in system.
 
Customer is now asking: who is responsible for her missing parcel, what happens to the opened parcel she received, and whether her item will be redelivered before the weekend.
 
Data scattered across email, WhatsApp, delivery system POD, driver app notes, and internal chat. No ticket formally linked across both waybills.

I don't even know where to start because I have been dealing with this for 4 days already and every time I contact DHL I have to repeat myself from the beginning. Nobody seems to know what is happening with my account or my shipment.
 
Let me explain everything from the start.
 
On 9 May I went to your website and booked a pickup for 2 parcels going to Johor Bahru. The booking went through, I got a confirmation email with reference number MY-PKP-8831045. I also made payment online via online banking for the shipment fees, total was RM47.00. The money already deducted from my Maybank account, I have the transaction receipt.
 
On 10 May between 10am to 1pm was my pickup window. Nobody came. I waited at home the whole morning. I even called my office to say I will be late because I was waiting. At 1.15pm I called the hotline. The agent (she said her name was Farhana) checked my booking number and told me the system shows pickup is "scheduled" and courier is on the way. She told me to wait until 2pm. I waited. Nobody came.
 
I called again at 2.30pm. Different agent this time. He said he cannot find my booking reference MY-PKP-8831045 in the system. He said maybe I typed the wrong number. I read it to him 3 times. He said the system is showing nothing under that reference. Then he told me to try rebook. I said I already paid RM47. He said he will raise a feedback form and someone will call me back in 1 hour.
 
Nobody called back.
 
That night at around 8pm I went back to the DHL website to check. The booking page showed an error message that said "Session expired, please rebook your shipment." But when I checked my Maybank transaction history, the RM47 charge was still there. So I was charged but the booking disappeared.
 
Because I needed to send the parcels urgently (one is a legal document with deadline and one is a gift for my sister's engagement on 11 May), I rebooked on the same night 10 May at 9pm. This time I used my husband's credit card because I was scared my Maybank had some issue. Total again RM47.00. New reference given: MY-PKP-8831209. I screenshot everything this time.
 
On 11 May morning new pickup window 9am to 12pm. Again nobody came. I called at 12.30pm. The agent this time said she can see MY-PKP-8831209 in the system but status shows "pending courier assignment". She said there was a system issue affecting bookings made on the night of 10 May and that the operations team is aware. She could not tell me when courier will come. She also could not tell me anything about my first booking MY-PKP-8831045 or my first payment of RM47.
 
By this time my sister's engagement gift parcel is now late. I had to ask my husband to drive to JB himself to send it. We spent RM120 in petrol and toll. And the legal document, I had to use a competitor courier and paid RM35 out of my own pocket because the deadline could not wait.
 
I am now out:
- RM47 first DHL payment (booking disappeared, no service provided)
- RM47 second DHL payment (pickup also never came)
- RM120 petrol and toll my husband drove to JB
- RM35 competitor courier for legal document
 
Total I lost RM249 because of DHL system failure. And I still have 2 parcels sitting in my house undelivered.
 
On 12 May I tried the DHL live chat. The chat agent said she will escalate to the e-commerce team and I will get email response within 24 hours. I asked can she confirm both my RM47 payments will be refunded. She said she cannot confirm anything, only the team can decide. I asked can I speak to a supervisor. She said supervisor not available and will call me back. I am still waiting for that call.
 
This morning 13 May I checked my email. No response from DHL. No callback. No refund. Both bookings still showing weird status on the app – first one says "booking not found" and second one says "pending".
 
I have attached the following to this email:
1. Screenshot of confirmation email for MY-PKP-8831045
2. Maybank transaction receipt RM47 on 10 May
3. Husband credit card statement showing RM47 on 10 May 11.04pm
4. Screenshot of "session expired" error message
5. Screenshot of MY-PKP-8831209 booking confirmation
6. Petrol receipt RM67 and Touch n Go statement showing RM53 toll
7. Receipt from competitor courier RM35
 
I want to make a formal complaint. I want full refund of both RM47 payments. I also want DHL to consider the additional costs I had to bear because your system failed. And I want someone senior to contact me, not a frontline agent who will just say "we will check and get back to you" and then disappear.
 
My contact number is 011-38821047. Best time to call is after 5pm on weekdays or anytime on weekends.
 
Thank you.
 
Hafizah Rosli

Hi DHL Customer Service,
 
I am writing this email because I have completely run out of options. I have called your hotline 3 times, used live chat twice, and even went to your service point in Damansara Uptown in person last Saturday. Nobody has been able to give me a straight answer and the situation is getting worse every day, not better.
 
I will lay everything out as clearly as I can. Please read this fully before responding because I am tired of receiving generic replies that do not address my actual problem.
 
---
 
BACKGROUND
 
I ordered a mechanical keyboard from an online seller on Shopee on 28 April. The item was shipped via DHL with waybill MY66123490. Tracking showed the parcel arrived at Shah Alam hub on 2 May and was out for delivery on 3 May.
 
---
 
WHAT ACTUALLY ARRIVED
 
On 3 May at around 2pm the courier came to my house. I signed for the parcel. The box looked normal from outside, same size roughly as what I expected. I brought it inside and opened it.
 
Inside was not a keyboard. It was a handheld blender still in its original Shopee seller packaging, with a completely different seller's name printed on the packing slip inside. The packing slip showed a different buyer name, different address in Rawang, and a different order number. Somehow my waybill sticker was on the outside of someone else's parcel.
 
I immediately took photos of everything – the outer box with my waybill sticker, the inner contents, the packing slip with the other buyer's name, and the Shopee packaging. I have 11 photos in total.
 
I called DHL hotline on 3 May at 3pm. The agent told me this sounds like a "mislabelling issue" and I need to not use the item and keep it for return. She raised a case and gave me case reference CAS-DHL-220503-01. She said within 2 working days someone will contact me to arrange collection of the wrong item and at the same time investigate where my actual keyboard went.
 
I said okay and waited.
 
---
 
FIRST FAILED COLLECTION ATTEMPT – 5 MAY
 
On 5 May a courier came to my house to collect the wrong item. I had it packed and ready. The courier scanned it, then called someone on his phone. After the call he told me he cannot take the parcel because "the system didn't generate a return waybill." He asked me to call customer service again. He left without taking the parcel.
 
I called hotline again on 5 May afternoon. New agent, no visibility into my previous case CAS-DHL-220503-01. I had to explain everything from scratch. She said she will re-escalate and courier will come again within 1 working day.
 
---
 
SECOND FAILED COLLECTION ATTEMPT – 6 MAY
 
A different courier came on 6 May morning. This time he had a waybill but it was printed with the wrong details – it showed the return going back to my address instead of back to the DHL hub or the original seller. He also refused to take the item. He said the waybill is wrong and if he scans it the system will create a loop.
 
I asked him to call his supervisor. He called someone, spoke for a few minutes, then said "sorry kak, you have to go to the service point to drop it off yourself." I told him this is not my fault, I should not have to go anywhere. He just apologised and left.
 
---
 
VISIT TO DAMANSARA UPTOWN SERVICE POINT – 7 MAY (THIS MORNING)
 
I went to the service point at 10am today with the parcel and all my photos. The staff there was polite but said she cannot process the return because the case is flagged as "courier collection required" and they are not authorised to override it at counter level. She printed a copy of my case notes and I could see that the notes from my first call on 3 May were there, but the two failed collection attempts on 5 and 6 May were not recorded anywhere. Date: 19 April 2026, 9:14 PM
Subject: My parcel never arrived for my wedding – waybill MY77823341

Hi,

I dont normally write emails like this but I really dont know what else to do anymore. I need someone to actually help me and not just tell me to wait.

My wedding was on 12 April. I ordered my hantaran decorations from a seller in Kelantan. She shipped everything via DHL on 7 April. Waybill MY77823341. The seller told me based on normal delivery time it should arrive by 9 or 10 April latest which is 2 days before my wedding. I was not worried at first because I had ordered early enough.

On 9 April I checked the tracking. It showed the parcel reached Shah Alam hub on 8 April and was out for delivery on 9 April morning. I stayed home the whole day. Nobody came. At 5pm the tracking updated to "delivery attempted – recipient not available". I was home the entire day. My mother was also home. We did not hear any knock or doorbell. No notice card was left. No missed call from any courier number on my phone. I checked my call log. Nothing.

I called DHL that evening at around 6pm. The agent said she will flag it and reattempt delivery will happen the next day 10 April. I said please make sure because my wedding is on 12 April and this parcel has all my hantaran dulang decoration items. She said she understood and noted it as urgent.

10 April came. Again nobody came. Tracking did not update the whole day. I called again at 2pm. The agent this time said the parcel is back at the hub and the system shows reattempt is scheduled but he cannot confirm what time. I asked can I just come and collect myself from the hub. He said I can walk in to the Shah Alam hub with my IC and tracking number. I asked my brother to go because I was busy with wedding preparations.

My brother went to Shah Alam hub on 10 April at around 4pm. The counter staff told him the parcel is not available for self collection because it has not been sorted back to the collection shelf yet. They told him to come back the next day 11 April after 10am.

11 April my brother went again. This time the counter staff said she cannot find the parcel. She checked twice. She said the system shows it is at the hub but physically she cannot locate it. She took my brothers number and said she will call when found. No call came.

By 11 April night I already had to go and buy replacement decorations from a shop in Jalan TAR. I spent RM340 on items that were not exactly what I wanted for my hantaran because everything was last minute and I had no choice. My original order from the Kelantan seller was RM280 for custom made items that I cannot replace like for like. The replacement items were generic and I am still upset about it when I look at my wedding photos now.

My wedding went ahead on 12 April alhamdulillah but the hantaran did not look the way I planned for almost a year. My mother cried a little when she saw it because she knew how much effort I put into planning it.

After the wedding I followed up again on 14 April. The parcel status in tracking had changed to "item in transit" which makes no sense because before it said it was at the hub. When I called the agent said she doesnt know why the status changed and will raise an investigation. She gave me case number CAS-DHL-140401-88. She said 3 to 5 working days for investigation result.

Today is 19 April. 7 working days have passed. Nobody contacted me. The tracking now shows "delivery pending" which is again different from before. I have called twice since 14 April and both times the agent said investigation is ongoing and they cannot give me update yet. One agent said he will ask the team to expedite. Nothing happened.

I want to know:
1. Where is my parcel right now and why has the status changed 3 times to 3 different things
2. Why was the "delivery attempted" on 9 April recorded when I was home and nobody came and no notice was left
3. Why could the hub not locate the parcel physically when the system said it was there
4. Who is responsible for the fact that I had to spend RM340 on replacement items because DHL could not deliver on time
5. What happened to case CAS-DHL-140401-88 and why has nobody contacted me in 7 working days

I am attaching:
- Screenshot of tracking history showing all the status changes
- My call log screenshot showing no missed calls on 9 April
- Receipt from Jalan TAR purchase RM340
- Original order receipt from Kelantan seller RM280
- My brothers photos taken at Shah Alam hub counter on 10 and 11 April

I am not a difficult person. I understand sometimes things go wrong. But this parcel was for my wedding. And after the wedding finished I have still been following up for more than a week with nothing resolved. I just want someone to be honest with me about what happened to my parcel and whether I will get any form of compensation for the extra money I had to spend.

Please respond to my email. Not a phone call. Email so I have a record.

Thank you.

Nurul Syahida
012-7734089
Klang, Selangor

incidents.raw_content:
Business customer complaint email on 7 March, subject: "Scheduled pickup never came – urgent export shipment missed". Account: BIZ-DHL-4821. Waybill (pre-generated): MY-EXP-00388120.

Customer is an SME exporter shipping electronic components to a buyer in Jakarta. Pickup was booked via DHL business portal on 6 March for a collection window of 9 AM–12 PM on 7 March. Customer had pre-packaged and labelled all 4 cartons. A shipment cut-off for the Jakarta flight was 3 PM the same day.

No courier arrived during the 9 AM–12 PM window. Customer called hotline at 12:15 PM. Agent confirmed booking exists and said courier is "on the way". No courier arrived by 2 PM. Customer called again; second agent could not locate the driver assigned to the booking and advised customer to "wait a bit more."

At 3:30 PM, customer received an automated SMS: "We were unable to complete your pickup today. Please rebook." No explanation provided.

Buyer in Jakarta expected the shipment for a production line deadline and has since emailed the customer threatening a penalty clause.

Internal routing system shows the pickup booking was assigned to a courier who called in sick on 7 March at 8:45 AM. Booking was not automatically reassigned. The sick-leave notification was only visible to that courier's direct supervisor, who was in a meeting until 11 AM and did not action the reassignment queue.

Hotline agents who took the two calls did not have visibility into the courier's sick-leave status or the unactioned reassignment queue. Both agents logged notes saying "courier in area, ETA unknown."

Customer is now seeking: written explanation of what happened, compensation for penalty clause from buyer, and priority pickup for the next available flight slot. Business relationship manager has not yet been looped in.

Data fragmented across portal booking, courier absence log, hotline call records, automated SMS system, and buyer email chain forwarded by customer. No single case owner assigned.

incidents.raw_content:
Business customer complaint email on 7 March, subject: "Scheduled pickup never came – urgent export shipment missed". Account: BIZ-DHL-4821. Waybill (pre-generated): MY-EXP-00388120.

Customer is an SME exporter shipping electronic components to a buyer in Jakarta. Pickup was booked via DHL business portal on 6 March for a collection window of 9 AM–12 PM on 7 March. Customer had pre-packaged and labelled all 4 cartons. A shipment cut-off for the Jakarta flight was 3 PM the same day.

No courier arrived during the 9 AM–12 PM window. Customer called hotline at 12:15 PM. Agent confirmed booking exists and said courier is "on the way". No courier arrived by 2 PM. Customer called again; second agent could not locate the driver assigned to the booking and advised customer to "wait a bit more."

At 3:30 PM, customer received an automated SMS: "We were unable to complete your pickup today. Please rebook." No explanation provided.

Buyer in Jakarta expected the shipment for a production line deadline and has since emailed the customer threatening a penalty clause.

Internal routing system shows the pickup booking was assigned to a courier who called in sick on 7 March at 8:45 AM. Booking was not automatically reassigned. The sick-leave notification was only visible to that courier's direct supervisor, who was in a meeting until 11 AM and did not action the reassignment queue.

Hotline agents who took the two calls did not have visibility into the courier's sick-leave status or the unactioned reassignment queue. Both agents logged notes saying "courier in area, ETA unknown."

Customer is now seeking: written explanation of what happened, compensation for penalty clause from buyer, and priority pickup for the next available flight slot. Business relationship manager has not yet been looped in.

Data fragmented across portal booking, courier absence log, hotline call records, automated SMS system, and buyer email chain forwarded by customer. No single case owner assigned.
